neighbours.label: ' when' introducing the technical condition under which something runs or applies ('called only when this file is main')
fire: # this block is executed only when the script is run directly
The cache is cleared only when the user logs out of the app.
The warning appears when the disk is more than 90 percent full.
# called when the socket receives new data
The backup job starts only when the laptop is plugged in.
This setting takes effect when the server is restarted.
# only used when DEBUG is enabled in the config
The fan turns on when the chip temperature passes 70 degrees.
quiet: We walked to the beach when the rain finally stopped.
She smiled when her brother walked through the door.
I was nine years old when we moved to Denver.
Text me when you get to the airport, please.
He laughed when he saw the cake on the table.
The town was quiet when the factory closed in 1990.
They cried when the old dog finally came home.
My mother sang when she cooked on Sunday mornings.

notes: Card top: '#is only called when this file is the main file'; mixed ' of', ' else'. Probe: 'runs only when the flag is set' 0.65 vs 'Call me when you arrive' 0.03. Mixed pole; ' them' after 'ignore' also fired.
